Hello, thank you for the summary of what has happened—or rather, what has not happened—over the last six months.
I would still like to request a refund.

I currently have two active orders: the first from April and the second from July. Since neither order has reached a shipping status yet, I do not wish to place a third one.
Therefore, I am requesting a refund for order Shop····. Thank you very much.

I'll start by reading the relevant skills and looking up this order. Here is the
reply to send: --- Hi Norman, Thank you for following up, and I am sorry. You
asked for an update on 10 September, asked again, and all you got back was a
holding reply. That is on us. Where your order stands today: Shop····, placed
on 9 April, is paid and has not shipped. The G. GT is still waiting on
stock and there is no confirmed ship date I can give you, so I am not going to
invent one. I have put a hold on the order on both our side and at the
warehouse, so nothing can leave while this is being settled. Your refund request
is now with a supervisor for review, with everything on it. A colleague picks it
up tomorrow from 10am Eastern and will come back to you directly by email with
the decision. I cannot promise you an amount or a date for that myself. If you
would rather not wait for that review, there are two things I can do for you
straight away, today, as soon as you say the word: Store credit for the full
$206.18 you paid, on your account, usable immediately on anything we have in
stock. Or a swap to a unit that is actually on the shelf at our Netherlands
warehouse and ships within 2 business days: a Hammer Miner BC04 (6 TH/s, $249)
or a Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 (4.2 TH/s, $229). Either one is more hashrate than the
GekkoAxe GT, and you would only pay the small difference. Just reply with which
of the three you want and I will act on it. Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
